attchmntText: Pokarna Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Special Window for Re-lodgement of Transfer and Dematerialization (Demat) requests of Physical Shares.
voiceSummary: Pokarna Limited published a newspaper advertisement on November 17, 2026, announcing a special window for the re-lodgement of transfer and dematerialization requests for physical shares. This facility remains open until February 4, 2027, in accordance with SEBI circular dated January 30, 2026. The window applies to physical securities transferred or dematerialized prior to April 1, 2019. Motilal Oswal Home Finance Limited issued a possession notice for a semi-furnished flat in Sangareddy District, Telangana, on November 13, 2026, against borrower Varalakshmi Tanneru. UGRO Capital Limited issued a demand notice on October 15, 2026, for Rs. 27,50,475 against Sri Venkatakrishna Coconut Company and others for secured assets in Siddipet District. Hero Housing Finance Limited issued demand notices on November 17, 2026, for various borrowers in Telangana.

attchmntText: Pokarna Limited has informed the Exchange about: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Update on Antidumping Duty Administrative Review by the U.S. Department of Commerce

Pokarna Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Publication of the  Extracts of Standalone & Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results  of the Company for the Quarter and the half year ended September 30, 2026, published today i.e. Wednesday, November 04, 2026 in Business Standard (English Newspaper) and Nava Telangana (Telugu Newspaper).

Pokarna Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the approved Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) along with Limited Review Report of the Company for the second quarter and the half year ended on September 30, 2026 & Code of practices and procedures for fair Disclosure of UPSI.
